messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] cdfs before the next release
parts:
Awesome! Here are the ones I added to the doc and added tests for:

inv_chi_square_cdf
inv_gamma_cdf
logistic_cdf
pareto_cdf
scaled_inv_chi_square_cdf
student_t_cdf
bernoulli_cdf
beta_binomial_cdf
binomial_cdf
neg_binomial_cdf
poisson_cdf


These are the ones that need to be vectorized / added:
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/beta.hpp    (just need to add tests and doc)
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/cauchy.hpp (same)
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/lognormal.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/normal.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/chi_square.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/double_exponential.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/exponential.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/gamma.hpp
- src/stan/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/weibull.hpp

I don't expect the tests to work right out the box when we merge into master -- Windows has an artificial limit on the size of Stan models. We'll merge and break apart some of the tests.


Daniel
